   • Solstice: completion of security questionnaire, provide test dataset/ingest, PO issuance
   • Redwood: provide SOC2 summary, environment for eval, support for private-offer activation, invoice & billing setup

3) Timeline proposal
   • Nov 19 — send security questionnaire + SOC2 bundle
   • Nov 22 — initial PoC kickoff (P0 tests)
   • Nov 29 — evaluation signoff and PO submission
   • Dec 3 — invoice issued; Dec 10 — payment expected; Dec 13 — production activation
